title: mimid-agent: kick, remove, ban and role-change operations for a room's admin
description: Decision mimid-1wgh.56 gives a hosted room's creator the admin role (canKick, canRemoveParticipant, canBan, canUnban, canChangeUserRole, canChangeRoleDefinitions), but mimid-agent-core and the JMAP bridge (mimid-agent-jmap) have no operation that uses them: removing another user from a mimid-agent room still needs another client or the operator (mimid admin remove|ban). Add Agent operations and map them to the JMAP Chat member-removal and role methods.
